svg.aria-label: Hostmortem. Open source · v0.1.0. It was fine, then it wasn’t, then someone rebooted it. Hostmortem keeps the minutes before on a Linux box and says what it knows, suspects and could not see. Built with C++20, Linux and SQLite. The screenshot shows the replay of a real upstream DNS outage on a five-lane tape, with the verdict underneath.
